confidence_rule.equivalence: For each of six comparisons use paired t TOST at alpha=0.05/6: 98.3333333333% two-sided t confidence interval for mean paired error must lie strictly inside (-Delta,+Delta). Every comparison must pass, with all acceptance anchors satisfied on all completed seed pairs. Non-significance of a difference never implies equivalence.
confidence_rule.failures: Budget exhaustion, invalid RNG pairing, missing outputs, failed anchors, OOM or nonfinite values fail that method/budget; retain in denominator, do not silently replace or discard. Statistical assumption failure yields inconclusive, never equivalent.
confidence_rule.speedup: Twenty paired log time ratios per method/budget. Report geometric mean baseline/method and one-sided t lower confidence bound, Bonferroni alpha=0.05/6. Worthwhile only if lower bound >1.05 and equivalence passes. Report raw pairs and costs. No stopping early or selection of best repetitions.

equal_outcome_target: Price the identical 8192 European calls with 262144 total paths per option, unchanged precision and analytic reference. Both anchors must hold; mean portfolio price error equivalent within frozen baseline-derived Delta. Ensemble cannot buy speed by reducing total samples, option coverage or validation. No claim of universal option-level accuracy.

equivalence_metrics.diagnostics: Record L1, per-option price differences, confidence widths and all reserve values. No numeric L1 target or tolerance supplied; none invented. Anchors are mandatory acceptance checks, not statistical equivalence tests. Portfolio equivalence does not establish per-option equivalence.

primary.quantity: Across-seed mean of portfolio-average discounted MC price minus analytic Black-Scholes price, averaged over the same 8192 options; compare method minus baseline in price units.
primary.scientific_tolerance: Symmetric margin Delta = 0.25 * s0, where s0 is sample SD of baseline portfolio-average MC-minus-BS error across the 256 baseline-only calibration seeds. Freeze s0 before viewing any method results.

primary.status: Prospectively chosen baseline-variability tolerance; quarter-SD is an explicit scientific assumption, not an upstream requirement or observed variability. Calibration supplies units, never method outputs. If s0 is zero/nonfinite, no statistical equivalence claim; new sealed run required.

evaluation_inputs.configuration: Strong scaling, one GPU, float, DOUBLE_PRECISION disabled, THREAD_N=256, PATH_N=262144 per option; grid cap 40*SM count. Freeze logical grid from baseline device. Reject tiny-device reduction of option count. Baseline uses streamed method.
evaluation_inputs.generated_specification: Pinned host generator srand(123), 8192 options in generator order; S in [5,50], X in [10,25], T in [1,5], R=0.06, V=0.10. Freeze libc version and serialize/hash the one baseline-generated input array before any method evaluation. Input hash currently unavailable; do not fabricate.
evaluation_inputs.scale_rule: Fixed published initial case only; no adaptive escalation. Intake final representative configuration is null; profile does not establish it. If fixed case too short or profile nonrepresentative, report limitation and require new sealed run for a changed scale.

hardware_cost_basis.allocation: Same physical GPU and host, exclusively allocated, methods sequential. Eight is a logical factor ceiling, not permission to use extra GPUs. Sum all member/shard work; no free concurrent resources.
hardware_cost_basis.budget_units: single-GPU reservation seconds per individual baseline or method evaluation, inclusive of associated CPU wall time in timing_scope; not aggregate experiment budget
hardware_cost_basis.environment: Target Lambda Stack Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.8, driver 570 per intake. Exact model, driver patch, SM count, clocks, libc and memory capacity unavailable. Record and freeze before calibration; require same environment throughout. No monetary price evidence.
hardware_cost_basis.profile_reference_status: Observed supplied profile wall duration only; workload constants and exact timing boundaries are not pinned by packet. No extrapolated duration is a new measurement.

paired_seed_tests.calibration_separation: Only baseline calibration can determine s0. No tuning on held-out seeds; repeated timing observations do not count as independent scientific samples.
paired_seed_tests.design: Stochastic common-random-number paired-seed equivalence, same option array and logical path IDs in baseline and method. Compare seed-level portfolio errors with paired TOST. No deterministic exemption: Monte Carlo remains stochastic even with fixed seeds.
paired_seed_tests.rng_contract: Upstream has no seed CLI and uses curand_init(blockIdx.x + gridDim.x * device_id, threadIdx.x, 0,...). Future evaluation harness must expose a common seed offset: seed argument = listed seed + baseline logical block ID, sequence = baseline logical thread ID, offset=0. Keep baseline logical grid and option/path stream assignment for both methods, independent of physical shard scheduling. Ensemble members use disjoint contiguous path ranges of this stream; do not duplicate paths. This is a prospective harness requirement, not existing implementation evidence. Failure to preserve mapping invalidates pairing; no post-hoc unpaired substitution.

provenance.seal_rule: Prospective protocol before method code. Any scope, tolerance, input scale, seed mapping, budget, sample size or analysis change requires a new sealed run.

sample_sizes.power_basis: Assume independent seed-level paired differences approximately normal, true mean difference zero, and paired SD <=2*s0. Delta/sigma >=0.125. Normal TOST sufficient planning inequality n >= ((z_(1-alpha)+z_(1-beta/2))*8)^2; allocate beta=0.10/6. Conservative quantile upper bounds 3 and 3 give n>=2304; sealed n=8192 exceeds this. Union bound targets >=90% joint power across two methods and three budgets. Calibration uncertainty and actual variance are unmeasured; this is conditional prospective power, not measured or guaranteed power.
sample_sizes.variance_check: Report paired SD/s0 and calibration uncertainty. If paired SD exceeds 2*s0 or normal/independence assumptions fail, mark power unsupported and result inconclusive for this protocol, even if a nominal interval fits. Do not increase samples or margins after looking.

scheduling_order: Paired baseline/method on same seed and budget, adjacent runs, RNG reset every run. Define deterministic random keys SHA256 of UTF-8 seal-v1|phase|method|budget|seed. Sort pair blocks lexicographically by hash; first hash byte even means baseline first, odd method first. Phase is timing or equivalence. Randomizes blocks and within-pair order reproducibly; baseline calibration completed and s0 frozen before either phase. No concurrent execution.

splits.held_out: 8192 seeds 100000..108191, used only for final scientific comparison; all 8192 options validated against analytic reference.
splits.timing: Seeds 1000..1019 separate from scientific calibration and testing. No model training; option train/test split not applicable.

timing_scope.amdahl: 1/((1-p)+p/k); supplied p=0.9631075222251976, k=8, ceiling=6.358050374956024 for both feasible methods. Forecast uses effective factor below k plus positive incremental launch/transfer/merge overhead. Profile includes RNG setup 0.002990271 s and pricing 10.269934918 s; H2D 0.000666656 s, D2H 0.000320928 s. No overhead measured for methods.

data-parallel over inputs.basis: Profile pricing kernel 10.269934918 s dominates; partition fixed option identities into eight logical shards on the same single GPU. Assumed effective factor 2 to 4 from scheduling/locality; eight shards do not imply eight GPUs or measured acceleration. Launch, input transfer, gather and ordered merge add 2% to 6% of baseline wall time. Saturated GPU may yield no gain; interval is a conditional prospective assumption.

ensembles.basis: Same compute-dominated profile; split each fixed 262144-path estimator into eight 32768-path members on one GPU. Preserve total paths and combine sufficient statistics with correct pooled variance. Assumed effective factor 1.5 to 3; launches, repeated transfers, member scheduling and statistical merge add 4% to 12% of baseline wall time. No claim that independent ensemble execution itself accelerates a saturated GPU.

timing_scope.primary: Full synchronized wall envelope from before allocation/RNG initialization through preprocessing, all launches, H2D, pricing, D2H, waits, shard/ensemble merge, CPU finalization and analytic validation. Include orchestration and cleanup before result availability. Same scope for baseline and methods; compilation excluded. This broad scope accommodates supplied whole-profile Amdahl ceilings conservatively.
timing_scope.secondary: Also report upstream streamed Total time covering preprocessing, transfers, GPU pricing and completion waits. It excludes allocation/RNG initialization and CPU finalization/Black-Scholes validation, so do not mix this with primary speedup.

warmup: For each implementation and budget perform exactly three untimed full fixed-input runs using timing seed 999, synchronize after each, restore fresh RNG state before each measured run. Warmup costs reported separately from per-evaluation budgets; no adaptive stabilization or cherry-picked exclusions.
